name: scaffold-deck
body: Scaffold deck: `init [path]` — check for existing slides/, assets/, templates/, kalide.yaml (the check is independent of `path`); with no path, write the minimal unbranded seed (deck + local `templates/`) from the scaffold's embedded seed; with a path, validate the external library at `path` fail-fast BEFORE writing anything (templates-dir-validation), then write the deck (`slides/`, `assets/`, `kalide.yaml` with `templates: <path>`) and no local `templates/`.
